items.prompt:
Photorealistic editorial portrait.
Waist-up portrait, front view. The camera is positioned extremely low near the ground and tilted steeply upward toward the woman, creating strong near-far scale through the closest visible body planes. Photographed directly from the front. Her chest, torso, and waist face the lens in a frontal waist-up silhouette.
A 20s seductive stunning Japanese or Korean woman with black frame, thin-frame glasses, full bust, narrow defined waist, young sweet pretty face, soft rounded charm, bright friendly eyes, gentle cute beauty, deep side-parted long soft waves, defined face-framing layers, polished wave shape, sleek close-to-head roots, restrained volume, compact hair silhouette, fine aligned strands, smooth uniform texture with a soft natural sheen, clean tapered ends, neatly framing the face, soft black-tea brown hair, muted brown-black salon tone, glass skin, dewy luminous skin texture, soft natural smile, relaxed brows, gently narrowed eyes, softly parted lips, lifted cheeks.
She wears refined boudoir styling, triangle bra top, high-cut string bottom at the lower crop edge, white satin lingerie set, slim straps, chain connectors, small charm hardware, silver heart-charm waist chain, multiple open heart motifs spaced across the front, a short vertical chain hanging from the center heart and ending in a smaller heart pendant, delicate jewelry around the waist and upper hips.
She lies on a bed that dominates the composition. Pillows, cushions, and a casually rumpled comforter rest on the bed, with one everyday item such as a book or phone nearby, creating a lived-in feeling.
Window-frame pattern light cast on the subject, framed daylight shadows.
